testcase.name: Pores, Teeth, and SmoothOrWrinkled carry no fields — there is nowhere to put a gill attachment
Observed has exactly two states, and they are never equal to each other
StipeDetails Present carries exactly position, interior, and base
a freshly-started log entry has every section unrecorded, not defaulted to a value
Feature has exactly three states, pairwise distinct
StipeDetails Absent carries no fields — an absent stipe has no interior or base to record
Gills carries exactly attachment, spacing, and edge — the only place those fields exist
an entry recorded as Pores cannot be asked for a gill attachment
